<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Probes an MCP server and returns its RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata and its authorization server's RFC 8414 or OpenID Connect Discovery metadata.
A server without Dynamic Client Registration is a 200 with dcr_supported false and no registration_endpoint; its client must be pre-registered.
A 422 carries error.type "oauth_discovery" and error.code "not_protected" (the server neither answered 401 nor publishes protected-resource metadata at a well-known URI) or "no_metadata" (it answered 401 but advertised no protected-resource metadata, by reference or at a well-known URI).
